description: Lab values: units, conversion to a canonical unit, and the physiologically plausible range in the canonical unit (3b contract, decision 3). Used to infer an unstated unit (only one unit gives a plausible value -> use it and state the assumption) and to reinterpret an implausible registry unit. An analyte is used only when status is 'verified' (every factor and the plausible range have a checked source); otherwise every comparison involving it is unknown.

mmol/L.source: PENDING: needs the hemoglobin monomer molar mass from a checked source (mmol/L is used clinically, e.g. in the Netherlands)

plausible.source: PENDING: reference interval source not yet checked (ABIM reference ranges PDF refused automated download; Merck Manual page has no numeric table)
